analysis.insight_summary: The discussion centers on the [product_name] unexpectedly entering STOP mode when used in Master mode on a LAN, but not when running as a Slave. Users are concerned about device reliability in networked setups. Using Slave mode appears to improve stability, though it is considered a costly workaround rather than an ideal solution.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] to work reliably in both Master and Slave modes over LAN, without random STOP events. They look for firmware updates or, if that fails, explicit advice regarding necessary hardware replacements.
